page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-64-highlssd belongs to the Storage Optimized machine family, engineered specifically for I/O-intensive workloads requiring vast amounts of direct-attached storage alongside substantial memory density. The instance is built on an x86_64 architecture and provides 64 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 504 GB of system memory, yielding roughly 7.88 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A primary architectural feature of the z4d-highmem-64-highlssd is its integrated local NVMe SSD storage tier. Equipped with 8 local SSDs delivering 30,065 GB of high-speed local capacity, this server avoids network-attached storage latency bottlenecks. Dedicated compute allocation ensures stable multi-tenant isolation, though accelerator capabilities are absent due to a zero GPU configuration. Additionally, complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided, necessitating standard cloud networking provisions.

From a cost-efficiency and performance perspective, the bundled massive local NVMe disk array offers exceptional throughput and latency characteristics without relying on independent persistent disk configurations. Because direct-attached NVMe storage is physically collocated on the host, workloads benefit from maximum local read and write operations, balanced against the transient nature of local scratch storage.

The hardware profile makes this machine instance appropriate for transactional databases, large-scale distributed NoSQL platforms, real-time analytics, and data warehousing engines that demand both high RAM footprints and extreme local input/output operations per second.
description: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-64-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine featuring 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 504 GB of RAM, providing an ample 7.88 GB of memory per core. Engineered for high-throughput, low-latency I/O performance, the instance integrates 8 local NVMe SSDs totaling 30,065 GB of high-speed direct-attached capacity. It operates without GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This dense compute and storage balance makes the instance cost-effective for large datasets requiring localized low-latency caching rather than costly remote persistent volumes. The server is suited for enterprise relational database deployments, high-performance distributed NoSQL data stores, real-time analytics engines, and data-intensive ETL processing.
